verses.text: [The believers] devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and to fellowship, to the breaking of bread and to prayer.
verses.title: Gathering to Grow in Christ

verses.text: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.
